response.rationale: Both A and B are about hive weight monitoring, just at different layers. A is the domain-layer logic: ScaleService (node f7e458262ae72ac4) has fan-out 11, and its label adds swarm detection, which builds on weight readings. B is the storage behind the same data: ScaleRepository (node 18ab235f6c31a91a, fan-in 3) and WeightReadingRepository (node 47ce227c703f72aa, fan-in 2). The graph doesn't list edges, so I can't confirm that ScaleService calls these repositories. Still, the names and layers fit: the service logic and the repositories that store scale and weight data. A's label is somewhat broader because of swarm detection, but it is an extension of weight monitoring rather than a separate capability. That difference is why my confidence is moderate.
